current.text: He is projected to come off the bench.
The Warriors' latest reported starting lineups use Curry, Podziemski, Green, Lendeborg and Santos. Melton is not in them.
The starting guard spot among Podziemski, Melton and Santos was called unclear. He has an outside shot to start.

If he starts and plays about 28 minutes, he is worth drafting or adding in every league. In that case he can beat last season's rank of 179. He is worth considering in 12-team leagues but not in 10-team leagues.
His knee recovery is a concern.
Josh expects him to do a bit more than last season.
Ranked in tier 9 of point guards.
Golden State's depth is very poor. The team struggles to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody are out early in the season. Their return could change the rotation.
Experts call the Warriors a bad team. The season may be a gap year, and the team may rest veterans to protect its lottery odds.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most. Their schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He is a steals specialist. His projected 1.6 steals per game is a league outlier.
He is a career above-average three-point shooter. He hit 36 to 39% from three before last season's slump after his injury return.
His FG% is low for a guard, about 41% projected.
He is a good defender but not a primary creator.
He is coming back from an ACL injury.
Steve Kerr often names a starting lineup and changes it a few games later. His rotations are hard to predict, with a lot of mixing among the wings.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 245, ESPN rank 181), so he sits outside our 144 drafted players. He is not worth an auction dollar unless he is named a starter before the draft. His draw is about 1.6 steals per game. The cost is about 41% FG on roughly 11 attempts, so he fits punt FG% builds that chase steals. In the first weeks, check whether he starts and plays around 28 minutes, and watch how his knee holds up. Also check how his role changes once Butler and Moody return.
